description: Read the seller of record, unit price, shipping, tax, and total for an instant-checkout listing. Does not charge a card. Requires buyer read access. Pass the returned checkout_id to confirm_purchase.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

product_id.description: Exact id from search, for example product_2731.

quantity.description: Units to buy. Must be below the quote threshold.

shipping_address_id.description: Optional. Shipping is the listing's shipping price; tax is not collected on this path.

name: preview_checkout

claims_summary.description: Inspection is 3 days after the buyer marks the order received. Short-unit claims apply beyond a 5% tolerance. Salvage is as-is. Not-received claims are allowed while the order is shipped.

title: Preview checkout
